# Feature: V6 Riss in der Realität (Arena-Swap Hauptaktion)

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-08-03 — issue #379 -->

## Intent
Under `v6Formula`, polish **Riss in der Realität** as a Hauptaktion Arena-swap: discard current arena, draw a new random arena from the pack; new arena applies immediately; already-fired old-arena effects are not undone. Distinct from Standard-Glitch content shipping (#378) — this ticket hardens engine semantics + DE UX + tests/docs.

## Preconditions
- Match under `v6Formula` + `V6_CORE_PACK`
- `glitch-riss` already in V6 Standard-Glitches (`src/content/v6/cards/glitchCards.ts`)
- Six core arenas shipped (#350)

## Happy Path
- [ ] `PLAY_GLITCH` with `glitch-riss` is legal in Aktionsphase under `v6Formula` and costs the Hauptaktion (`phase → end`)
- [ ] Current arena replaced by a different random arena from the pack (no V1 `d6Variants` under V6)
- [ ] New arena rules apply immediately (e.g. Club Luft-Bonus after swap)
- [ ] Already-applied player state from old arena (HP, Schild, Marks) is not undone
- [ ] Match identity meta preserved (`v6FormulaEnabled`, Echo/Delay queues, Affinity, equipment flags, …)
- [ ] DE lastEvent / Spielregeln clarify: gilt sofort; alte Trigger nicht rückgängig
- [ ] Unit tests + SPIELANLEITUNG_V6 / spielkonzept §29–32 sync

## Edge Cases
- [ ] Single-arena pack edge: switch may re-pick same id (pool fallback)
- [ ] Leaving Vulkan mid-turn without attack: end-turn Vulkan −1 does **not** apply (current arena is no longer Vulkan)
- [ ] V1 Base pack `switchArena` still rolls `d6Variants` when present
